artifacts.notes: The 24247801-byte ZIP duplicates the exact JPEG streams already retained in the 23705230-byte 40-page PDF. It is remote solely to avoid retaining a second approximately 24 MB representation of those same image bytes. Its exact bytes are reconstructible offline from the retained PDF using Poppler pdfimages, the retained index and holding-library manifest, and the retained rebuild-source-selection.py recipe. The recipe verifies every member and the final ZIP SHA-256. The source_url identifies the acquisition manifest, not a publicly hosted ZIP. Reopen direct image URLs only if source reacquisition is needed. No whole-book PDF was acquired or hashed.
